name: Krimi Kuthar Ras

sections.introduction: Krimi Kuthar Ras is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This is known to treat problems related with stomach worms.
sections.ingredients:
Karpura – Cinnamomum camphora – 80 g 

 10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Ajamoda – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Indrayava – Holarrhena antidysenterica 
 Trayamana – Gentiana kurroo 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (Mercury) 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Juice extract of Vijaya – Cannabis sativa – quantity sufficient for grinding for one day 
 Seed powder of Palasha – Butea monosperma – 150 g 
 Mushakarni – quantity sufficient for grinding. 
 Brahmi – Bacopa monnieri – juice extract quantity sufficient for grinding. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients from number 1 to 8. Mix them all and put in mortar pestle with extract of Vijaya for six hours. 
 Then take palasha, mushakarni and brahmi and tincture with first mixture. 
 Now take the paste up to 250 mg and make their pills. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 As the name suggests, Krimi Kuthar is an ayurvedic preparation which is beneficial for stomach worms like helminthiasis. The herbs included in this formulations are kapura, ajmoda, vidanga, indrayava etc. These herbs have antioxidant, analgesic, carminative, anthelmintic, astringent, anti-toxic properties in it. These have constituents like cineol, pinene, terpineol, menthol, thymol, terpenoids, conessine, isoconessimine, conessimin, conimin,amarogentin, gentiopicrin, embelin, christembine, homoembelin, vilangine,pseudo-aconitine, mensuol, silosterol, fatty acids, mesuanic acid, cannabidiol, vit A, B1, B2, B6, C, D, F, omega acids, herpestine, apigenin etc. in it. Due to its anthelmintic property it expels out parasitic worms from the body. It has de-worming action due to which it acts against intestinal worms like helminthiasis etc. Due to its anti-oxidant property it detoxifies the body. It is beneficial in anorexia and many other related problems.
sections.dose: One pill, One to two times a day, before or after meals, with black salt.
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
